entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2667 on digitalisation of the visa procedure
entries.review_state: Official English EUR-Lex text and instrument identity reviewed on 2026-10-23; the Croatian route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. The act amends the Visa Code, VIS and related instruments; it is not a consolidated Visa Code. Article 8(2) sets general application from the Commission decision under Article 7(1), with exceptions in Article 8(3). Verify the decision and Croatian participation before treating the EU Visa Application Platform as operational. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1191 simplifying requirements for certain public documents
entries.review_state: The official English text and Article 2 scope were reviewed on 2026-10-23. It covers specified Member-State public documents, including marriage and parentage records; Article 2(3) excludes third-country public documents and Article 2(4) excludes recognition of the legal effects of another Member State's document. The Croatian route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

entries.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2685 on digitalisation of the visa procedure
entries.review_state: Official English text and instrument identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. This amending act changes the uniform visa format to a digital format, but Article 3 defers general application to a Commission implementing decision under Article 2(1), with a limited exception for Article 1 point 2 from 27 December 2023. Check the decision in the Official Journal before describing digital visas as operational. This is not a consolidated text of Regulation (EC) No 1683/95. The Croatian route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.
